# Balance mod: the game's file, copied whole, with only the colony window's
# building lock added to each type's can_destroy (balance_building_not_kept).
# Generated by write_building_locks.py -- rerun it after every game update.
marketplace = {
	audio_tier = 1
	is_foreign = no
	max_levels = marketplace_max_level
	pop_type = burghers
	
	category = trade_category
	
	employment_size = trade_employment

	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	
	build_time = merchant_build_time

	unique_production_methods = { 
		marketplace_maintenance = {
			cloth = 0.06
			jewelry = 0.05
			paper = 0.05
			salt = 0.06

			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}
	
	construction_demand = town_building_construction
	
	modifier = {
		local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.01
		local_burghers_estate_power = 0.1

		local_market_access = 0.005


		local_merchant_power = 1
		local_trades_per_burgher = 1
		local_merchant_capacity = 1
	}
	ai_forbid_shutdown = yes  # Balance mod: no AI ever closes it
	can_destroy = { balance_building_not_kept = yes  # Balance mod: colony window building lock
	}
}
